statement: There exists a fixed one-layer polynomial-precision nonlinear MLP RNN whose language is P-complete under FO reductions. Consequently, if NC is not equal to P, there is a nonlinear RNN that cannot, for any fixed k, be simulated by polynomial-size bounded-fan-in circuit families of depth O(log^k n).

existential: one fixed P-complete language with polynomial padding
one fixed one-layer nonlinear MLP RNN recognizing it
universal: every fixed exponent k in the conditional circuit statement
quantifiers.obligation: The RNN exactly simulates the fixed polynomial-time multi-stack machine with polynomial-bit precision.

assumptions: The input language includes enough explicit padding symbols for one recurrent step per simulated machine step.
Stack values are exact rationals with polynomially many bits.
The recurrent gate is a fixed finite ReLU MLP with rational weights.
A standard P-complete language and its polynomial-time multi-stack recognizer are used.
FO reductions are closed under composition with the fixed recognizer.

primary_reference.title: On the Computational Power of Neural Nets
primary_reference.authors: H. T. Siegelmann and E. D. Sontag

pass_condition: A gapped exact-rational stack encoding has symbolic push, pop, head, and empty proofs; fixed ReLU selectors implement the finite transition table; bit length is polynomial in padded input length; the padding map preserves P-completeness under FO reductions; the NC-versus-P conclusion remains conditional; the independent complete bounded-domain checker passes; and the paper's vanishing-margin base-2 construction is rejected.
fail_condition: Any source mismatch, derivation mismatch, lost encoding gap, stack-operation mismatch, super-polynomial precision, dropped padding or conditional assumption, or negative-control pass exits nonzero.
limitations: This independently repairs the paper's base-2 stack proof using a gapped base-4 encoding. It verifies the exact existential P-completeness claim, not the stronger unpadded claim that an RNN can provide arbitrarily many internal steps per input symbol. The circuit lower bound remains conditional on NC != P.
